name: Keyring E2E e Rotatividade de Chaves Mestras

security_capabilities_verified: Dynamic versioned Keyring resolution supporting simultaneous 256-bit AES-GCM master keys
Bidirectional normalization of numeric and string key versions (1, '1', 'v1', 'v2')
Environment variable parsing from MCT_KEYRING_JSON, KEYRING_JSON and active version overrides
Guaranteed buffer zeroing (.fill(0)) in finally blocks for keys and decrypted plaintext
Webhook ingress active key encryption and explicit key_version persistence in channel_webhook_inbox
DatabaseSigningSecretResolver multi-key decryption supporting rotation of stored credentials
Automatic fallback across keyring versions in decryptPayload on auth tag mismatch when version is unspecified
Worker batch claiming and processing of heterogeneous batches (v1 and v2) with zero downtime
Fail-closed behavior on unknown key versions (e.g. 99) with UNKNOWN_KEY_VERSION error and retry scheduling

acceptance_criteria.evidence: crypto-payload.ts implementa Keyring, normalizeKeyVersion, getActiveKeyVersion, parseKeyringFromEnv e zeramento seguro de buffers com 13 testes unitarios 100% aprovados.
buildApp e rotas Fastify utilizam activeKeyVersion para cifrar e persistir payloads no inbox com a coluna key_version correspondente.
DatabaseSigningSecretResolver aceita keyring e decripta credenciais sob chaves legadas e ativas com fallback automatico em caso de chave nao especificada.
Worker processa com sucesso lote misto contendo itens cifrados com chave versao 1 e chave versao 2, inserindo mensagens e finalizando status.
Itens com key_version desconhecido (99) lancam UNKNOWN_KEY_VERSION e sao reagendados sem interromper ou causar crash no runtime do worker.
Suites crypto-keyring.test.ts, keyring-e2e-rotation.test.ts e total de 27 suites do monorepo (332 assercoes) executadas com 100% de sucesso contra banco hermetico.
